---
name: handoff
description: Compress verified task state for a long session, interruption, agent change, or deferred work.
---
# Handoff

Use for compaction, handoff, or deferred work. Record goal, changed files, decisions, current evidence, unresolved risks, exact next action, and definition of done using the shared handoff template.

Do not dump conversation history. Exit with a successor able to resume without stale assumptions. Reject: “the diff explains it” when decisions and verification are absent.
